roomSummary: This is a long open-plan living and dining room with carpeted flooring, leading to a modern kitchen with a breakfast bar at the far end. The living area occupies the spacious foreground, while the dining zone sits naturally in the mid-ground directly in front of the kitchen.
camera: The camera stands in the foreground of the living area, looking straight down the room toward the kitchen peninsula and cabinetry at the far end.

landmarks.description: White kitchen peninsula bench at the rear of the room
Pair of dark pendant lights hanging over the kitchen bench
Wall-mounted heat pump unit on the bulkhead near the kitchen
Tall vertical window on the right wall in the mid-ground
High horizontal window with roller blind on the foreground right wall
Power outlet low on the prominent left wall in the foreground
Interior doors along the left corridor leading towards the kitchen

relationships: The dining table remains in the mid-ground near the kitchen bench, keeping clear separation from the living area.
The sofa faces the left wall TV unit, with its back subtly partitioning the living zone from the dining zone.
A clear, unobstructed walking corridor is maintained along the left side to allow smooth access past the doors to the kitchen.
avoid: Do not place the dining table in the foreground living area.
Do not position furniture that blocks the hallway doors on the left.
Do not place tall furniture in front of the tall vertical window on the right wall.
Do not block the kitchen peninsula with oversized dining furniture.
